cases.prompt: Set up a process to manage subject rights requests (DSARs) in Microsoft 365.

expect.label: Priva SRR is retired - handle DSARs in Purview eDiscovery (Premium)
Priva depends on accurate classification - SITs first
Coordinate with legal / privacy office before going live
Apply least-privilege roles; DSAR content is highly sensitive
Test DSAR workflow with a dry-run before publishing intake form

cases.prompt: Which Priva solution should I roll out first?

expect.label: Start with Privacy Risk Management overexposure before scaling DSARs
Reason: leaks generate more DSARs than you can handle

cases.prompt: What licence do I need for subject rights requests after the Priva SRR retirement?

expect.label: Priva Privacy Risk Management is a separate add-on SKU, not bundled in M365 E5 Compliance
DSARs now need eDiscovery (Premium) licensing; no more per-request SRR bundles
